history.content: honestly im just annoyed. my girlfriend forgot our anniversary last week and i cant let it go
That sounds really annoying, and maybe a bit stuck in your mind because it mattered. Was it more like feeling disrespected, or more like frustration that it got missed?
i guess not disrespected exactly. more like... i had this whole night planned and she just blanked on it. like it didnt even register for her
That sounds more like frustration and a little let-down — like you had something real in mind and it just didn’t land for her. Did it feel more blocked or sharp, or did it make you want to pull back?
yeah pull back i think. i didnt even say anything to her about it. just kind of went quiet. feels stupid to be this bothered but it stings that i remembered and she didnt
That sting makes sense to me — it sounds like a quiet hurt wrapped inside the frustration. Do you want to stay with it a little, or leave it here for now?
yeah hurt is probably the right word for it. i think ill leave it here. maybe ill actually just tell her instead of sulking. thanks
That feels like a clear place to pause. Thanks for telling me what it is.
